messages.subject: [acs-r] table B15002H
messages.body_plain:
I'm fairly new to use of this ACS package.  I'm currently trying to work 
with tables B15002 & B15002H at the county level.  Table B15002 appears 
as fetchable, but not B15002H.  I understand some estimates at the 
county level in Table B15002H are suppressed because they are 
unreliable, but for the many that are not suppressed and are available 
on FactFinder, it would be speedier to work with the data through this 
package than to manually download files from FactFinder.

If this is something anyone in this group might have experience with, 
tips/suggestions would be much appreciated!

Thanks.

-- 

Elizabeth Tighe, Ph.D.
Research Scientist
Steinhardt Social Research Institute
Brandeis University

messages.subject: [acs-r] table B15002H
messages.body_plain:
>From what I can tell, the B15002X tables (e.g., B15002A, B15002B,
B15002H, etc.) are not available via the census API, and thus not
available through the acs package.  You can get this data via
factfinder and import it to R.

However, there is a "C15002X" version with all the A, B, C options
(i.e., C15002, C15002A, C15002H, etc.) -- pretty much the same data,
but the educational levels are grouped a bit (fewer categories).
Compare
<https://factfinder.census.gov/faces/affhelp/jsf/pages/metadata.xhtml?lang=en&type=table&id=table.en.ACS_15_5YR_B15002#main_content>
and
<https://factfinder.census.gov/faces/affhelp/jsf/pages/metadata.xhtml?lang=en&type=table&id=table.en.ACS_15_5YR_C15002H#main_content>.

Hope that helps.

--Ezra
